reproduction: python scripts/diagnose_phenomt_rotation.py --backend torch --case baseline high_mass_ratio --only22 0 --sample-rate 2048 --samples 257 --output receipt.json --reference-check --reference-backend torch --reference-case baseline high_mass_ratio --reference-rate 512 2048 8192 --reference-distance 50.0 100.0 200.0
scope: Isolated project_modes rotation/convention checks against public binary J-frame and L0 modes; does not validate native spin evolution, carrier, or physical waveform accuracy.

conventions.angles: Public alpha, acos(cosbeta), epsilon series are passed as alpha,beta,gamma.
conventions.projection: J-frame modes are projected at phi=0 with exp(2 i zeta), matching project_modes.
conventions.modes: only22=1 checks the complete l=2 set; only22=0 checks all available l=2..5 signed modes.
conventions.relative_l2: norm(project_modes output - direct J-frame projection)/norm(direct projection).
conventions.inverse_l0: For f_ref=f_min=20 Hz, Eq. 8 uses constants (-gamma_ref,-beta_ref,-alpha_ref) on all signed J modes and compares with public L0Modes.
conventions.inverse_l0_status: Full-mode inverse values are measured diagnostics; only22 inverse values are suitable for the strict convention check.
conventions.reference_check: At the initial f_ref=f_min sample, Eq. 8 implies coprec=L0. Per-ell relative metrics divide by the corresponding mode-vector norm; absolute metrics use strain units. Reference rows override the listed sample rate and distance. The factorial Wigner oracle uses 80 decimal digits, then rounds to complex128 before matrix-vector multiplication.

inverse_l0.reason: Full signed-mode inverse residual is reported for diagnosis; no full-mode accuracy gate is claimed.
